name: Bin Chuan Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Bin Chuan Enterprise Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells metal stamping products for computer and consumer electronics in Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers laptop metal casings and components, laptop keyboard base plates, mobile phone metal casings and components, home theater metal casings and meshes, POS system metal components, medical devices, and laptop keyboard plastic keycaps and scissor switches. Its products are installed in consumer electronics, laptop computers, multi-function printers, printers, power suppliers, computer CD-ROMs, uninterruptible power suppliers, monitors, etc. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
